title: La couronne de Nistark
lyrics:
[Intro: magical harp glissando, sparkling glockenspiel]
(Ding, ding, ding !)
Venez danser !

[Verse 1: children's choir, playful]
Petite fée, vole, vole
Bats des ailes, vole, vole
Monte au ciel tout là-haut
Au château de Nistark !

[Chorus: children's choir, joyful, sing-along]
La couronne, la couronne
Sur ma tête, elle rayonne
On danse, on tourne en rond
La couronne de Nistark !

[Verse 2: children's choir, playful]
Princesse, tourne, tourne
Sur tes pieds, tourne, tourne
Fais la révérence, hop !
Au château de Nistark !

[Chorus: children's choir, joyful, sing-along]
La couronne, la couronne
Sur ma tête, elle rayonne
On danse, on tourne en rond
La couronne de Nistark !

[Verse 3: children's choir, playful]
Sirène, nage, nage
Fais des vagues, nage, nage
Plouf ! dans l'eau du bassin
Au château de Nistark !

[Chorus: children's choir, joyful, sing-along]
La couronne, la couronne
Sur ma tête, elle rayonne
On danse, on tourne en rond
La couronne de Nistark !

[Bridge: children's choir, building up, call and response]
Le château, grand, grand, grand
Lève les bras, grand, grand, grand
La fée vole (vole, vole !)
La princesse tourne (tourne !)
La sirène nage (nage, nage !)
Et tout le monde saute ! (Hop !)

[Chorus: children's choir, big and joyful, full orchestra]
La couronne, la couronne
Sur ma tête, elle rayonne
On danse, on tourne en rond
La couronne de Nistark !

[Chorus: children's choir, big and joyful, full orchestra]
La couronne, la couronne
Sur ma tête, elle rayonne
On danse, on tourne en rond
La couronne de Nistark !

[Outro: harp glissando, glockenspiel sparkle]
Nistark ! (Hourra !)

[End]
styles: A joyful, bouncy children's song sung in French by a cheerful children's choir, like a musical number from a classic animated fairy-tale movie, with sparkling glockenspiel and celesta, magical harp glissandos, playful pizzicato strings, bright flutes and a light orchestra, simple sing-along nursery rhyme melody in a major key, light marching percussion and handclaps to dance to, 120 BPM, bright, warm and polished production, around 2 minutes 30.
exclude: EDM, electronic drop, dubstep, synth bass, opera, operatic vocals, dark, scary, minor key, dramatic, autotune, vocoder
